sentences.text: Leanne Carter (client) stated she is seeking protection from her ex-partner, Ryan Hale, with whom she had a six-year relationship that ended in August.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she still resides at 9 Calder Court in her own name only.
Leanne Carter (client) has a four-year-old daughter, Mia, who is currently at nursery.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed Ryan Hale is Mia's father.
Leanne Carter (client) described Ryan Hale coming to the flat every weekend since August (except one week when he was away) between Friday and Saturday nights, shouting through the
Leanne Carter (client) disclosed that on the 12th of October, Ryan Hale put his hands around her neck in the hallway while she was opening the door to give him Mia's bag.
Leanne Carter (client) stated Mia was asleep in her room during the incident on the 12th of October.
Leanne Carter (client) stated her neighbour called the police after hearing her screaming, and the police arrested Ryan Hale.
Leanne Carter (client) stated Ryan Hale was released on bail, which ran out, and is now released under investigation without bail conditions.
Leanne Carter (client) stated she went to the GP two days after the 12th of October, where the doctor recorded marks on her neck.
Leanne Carter (client) disclosed that on the 20th of October, Ryan Hale smashed her phone after she tried to hand it to him.
Leanne Carter (client) stated she told the officer on the case about the phone smashing and had to replace it, costing approximately two hundred pounds.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed Ryan Hale sent her a text on the 3rd of November threatening to kill her.
Leanne Carter (client) disclosed that her friend Gemma told her Ryan Hale keeps a knife in his van for work.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she has never seen a knife in Ryan Hale's van herself.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she works part-time at a pharmacy for about eighteen hours and receives Universal Credit.
Leanne Carter (client) stated Ryan Hale has parental responsibility for Mia as he is on the birth certificate.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she has a crime reference number on her phone and will send it to the solicitor.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she has screenshotted the threatening text and voice notes containing threats.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she can obtain her bank statements and Universal Credit statement online.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she consents to the solicitor writing to the GP for records.
Leanne Carter (client) stated her priority is for Ryan Hale to stop coming to the flat and stop messaging her.
Leanne Carter (client) stated she does not want Mia to see Ryan Hale until the situation is resolved.
Leanne Carter (client) confirmed she agrees to the solicitor's advice to apply for a non-molestation order.
Leanne Carter (client) stated she will email the crime reference, screenshots, voice notes, and bank statements by Wednesday the 25th.
